# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Lab lead: [Shreya Shankar](https://www.sh-reya.com/). Code: [github.com/fsdatalab](https://github.com/fsdatalab).

## Projects

- [DocETL](https://docetl.org): an agentic map-reduce system for processing large unstructured datasets with LLMs.
- [Quail](https://github.com/fsdatalab/quail): an execution engine for AI functions in SQL (and DocETL), with open source LLMs.
- [DocWriter](https://docwriter.org): an IDE for AI-assisted writing.

## Getting involved

People from non-traditional backgrounds (in industry, outside CS, or in high school) can start by using Quail to analyze a dataset and sending a short video explaining the analysis. CMU students and prospective postdocs should reach out directly; prospective PhD students should apply to CMU CSD. Details and ideas: {{ '/working-with-us/' | absolute_url }}
